review_scope: Pinned Device Tree, PWM, regulator, and callback source evidence

independent_input_audit.reviewer_result: All declared MP6 inputs and cited evidence match the reviewed artifact and pinned source volume.

findings: The regulator of_regulator source confirms supply-name expansion to the -supply DT property and supports mapping fan,avdd to fan,avdd-supply.
The PWM core translator maps cell 0 to channel index and cell 1 to period; the pinned LPG provider does not set a custom of_xlate. The static mapping of channel 3 and period cell 40000 is supported.
The stock call ledger and assembly support the gpiod_direction_output_raw callsites 0010137c and 001013bc.
The numeric equality reg=0xef00 and triled_base=0xef00 does not establish a hardware relation; indirect or pointer-based MMIO is not excluded by the direct-call inventory.
open_items: Runtime overlay application and later target DT changes are unconfirmed.
Actual regulator, GPIO, pinctrl, and PWM provider binding and runtime state are unverified.
Raw GPIO ownership, PWM runtime return behavior, physical voltage/fan response, and reg=0xef00 semantics remain open.
review_notes: Independent readiness review only. MP6 remains EXTRACTED_REVIEW_REQUIRED; no formal gate PASS or candidate edit authorization is established.
